articles.title: First New Sea Spider Species in 100 Years Discovered in Salish Sea
articles.summary: Scientists found two new sea spider species in the Salish Sea — the first in nearly a century. One has hairy legs and red eyes; the other is named after an ancient Indigenous village.

articles.title: Harvest Moon 2026: First Full Moon of Autumn Rises With Saturn This Weekend
articles.summary: The Harvest Moon — the first full moon of autumn — rises Saturday, Sept. 26. Look east at moonrise to see it glowing near bright Saturn. No telescope required.

articles.title: Dead Star Produces Shock Wave That Shouldn't Exist, Astronomers Say
articles.summary: Astronomers found a dead star blasting a giant shock wave — but it lacks the disc of material usually needed. The discovery challenges ideas about how dead stars interact with space.
